description: SESSION COMPILED LIKE THE STREAMER: e2e_baseline, but the session the host runs is what SessionCompiler (the launcher's own start-up compile, run on the builder) makes from the fixture as the golden master for a Vision Pro (bitrate-sized stream, foveation from the picture edges and Apple's map, pairing). Same checks as the baseline: the compiled session must stream, decode and pace like it. 3 runs of this must not differ from e2e_baseline beyond noise before the compile is trusted for more scenarios. negotiated.view_resolution is what the compile makes of 250 Mbps at 90 Hz for the Apple profile (2400 x 1856 per eye, 2026-11-09), not the golden 3552 x 3200. OPEN, PRODUCT BUG (2026-11-09): the stamp readback (gray_patch, counter_*) fails because the host does not apply a NEGATIVE centre shift: tools/host/src/main.rs (the foveation keys loop, ~line 1137) sets each key only when the value is > 0, so shift -0.036 / -0.374 stays at the Settings default 0.4 / 0.1 while the size and ratio are applied. Proof: the edges measured in the decoded stamp row (19 39 59 81 104 128 154 182 213 .. 596 660) equal the oracle (lib.py fov_vars / fov_forward) run with shift 0.4 / 0.1, not with the session value. The client is sent the session value, so it would decompress with another map than the host compressed with. The oracle is right; this scenario stays failing until the host takes negative shifts
